newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur fuel oil falls $3 with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur fuel oil falls $3 with crude.

text.p: NWE low sulphur fuel oil was around $3 a tonne weaker on Thursday as crude oil futures slipped, traders said.
Low sulphur cargoes remain well offered in northwest Europe and refiners reported a little buying interest from refiners in the Mediterranean. But no deals were heard to have been done.
Low sulphur swaps for March were talked at around $96 fob NWE by the day's end.
High sulphur barges were weaker and traded between $92 and $94 fob ARA.
High sulphur cargoes remain well offered with at least two pieces thought to be on offer in ARA. Utility player saw an offer from ARA at $96 cif NWE.
